assumptions_and_limitations: Driver course context: tee shot, starting lie tee, distance 380 m, hole 380 m, fairway half-width 15.0 m, rough beyond.
7-Iron / PW course context: fairway approach, pin at target distance, green radius 10.0 m, rough beyond.
Carry-as-stop: first ground contact treated as final lie; bounce and roll excluded.
Scoring benchmark: approximate historical PGA Tour strokes gained lookups, not player handicap.
Scoring unit: per single identical hypothetical opportunity (or per 100 identical opportunities); no per-round extrapolation.

No universal best shape: 7-iron Fade is favorable (+8/0/0) and Draw unfavorable (0/-8/0); PW Draw is favorable (+6/0/2) and Fade unfavorable (1/-6/1); Driver Draw is favorable (+6/0/2) and Fade unfavorable/neutral (1/-4/3).
Primitive shaft-twist SD is an orientation error about the delivered shaft axis, not delivered face-angle SD.
Correlated grid cells share pseudorandom seeds and are not independent experimental replications.
Monte Carlo bootstrap intervals quantify simulation sampling noise, not empirical certainty.
Parameter sensitivities (+/- 20% CG depth, inertia, face radii) are illustrative sensitivity tests, not measured uncertainty intervals.
Full publication acceptance remains pending; only numerical facts are qualified.
